item.title: Organise a permitted film screening
item.context_text: A student society wants to share a short documentary. The permission you received covers particular uses.
item.objective_text: Plan an accessible screening that fits the filmmaker’s permission.
success_conditions: Plan an accessible screening that fits the filmmaker’s permission.

children.title: Read the information
children.instructions: Read the note and use its details to answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
FILMMAKER'S PERMISSION
You may show the documentary once to an in-person audience of up to sixty, free of charge. A caption file can be emailed for use at the event. Posting the full film online, even on an unlisted link, needs a separate licence. You may post a trailer of up to forty seconds using the official clip. The hall seats fifty-five and several attendees have asked about captions.

questions.prompt: Which online use is already allowed?
options: Posting the full film as an unlisted link
Sharing the official trailer within forty seconds
Selling access to a recorded screening
questions.explanation: The permission explicitly allows the official short clip and treats the full film separately.

questions.prompt: What should the society request for accessibility?
questions.explanation: The filmmaker offers the caption file for the event.

children.title: Send the screening plan
children.prompt_text: Committee: Can we put the film online afterwards and announce captions?
children.instructions: State what the permission covers, offer an allowed online option, and say how you will get captions.
children.model_answer: We can hold one in-person screening in the hall. To make it accessible, I'll request the caption file and test it before the event. Posting the full film needs a separate licence, so our online announcement should use the official trailer within forty seconds.

children.title: Respond to an unlisted-link suggestion
children.prompt_text: Volunteer: What if we upload it without making the link searchable?
children.instructions: Explain the restriction and give a permitted alternative.
children.goal: Explain the boundary clearly and respectfully.
children.model_answer: Even an unlisted link would still be an online upload of the full film, so we need a separate licence. We can share the official short trailer now.
